summary.name: Affinity Photo
summary.one_liner: Serif's professional photo editor for pixel-based editing, RAW development and retouching, offered free of charge.
use_cases: Cleaning up distractions with generative fill
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Affinity Photo as a photo editor with RAW development, retouching, HDR, batch processing, macros and unlimited layers. Edits are non-destructive by default, and undo history can be saved with the file. It can import PSD files with layer fidelity and uses an open .af file format for collaboration. AI tools include Generative Expand, Generative Fill, Smart Selections, Depth-Aware Masking, Portrait Blur, Colorize and Super Resolve. GPU acceleration is said to keep brush strokes, zoom and filters responsive on large files.
notable: Free with no restrictions on tools, layers or export, per the FAQ
Non-destructive editing with saveable undo history
Imports PSD files with layer fidelity
Generative AI tools for fill, expand and super resolution
caveats: Canva AI Studio features require a Canva premium plan (Pro, Business, Enterprise or Education)
The page does not name Windows or other platforms; macOS is only confirmed via the awesome-mac listing
